first_public_date_evidence: arXiv:2209.01795 initial submission on 2022-09-05 (UTC), not its later revisions or journal publication
integrity: The proof is a finite-state induction valid for all finite forests, supplemented but not established by finite exhaustive tests. Verification is not external certification. Scientific comparisons distinguish published scalar results, generic counting tractability, and the explicit recurrence.
limitations: Limited to forests; generic MSO counting metatheorems already establish polynomial-time existence in principle; the exact eight-state construction rather than generic tractability is the contribution. One highly relevant 2024 super-domination polynomial chapter was available only as abstract, leaving an overlap risk. Coefficients require arbitrary-precision integers.
scientific_contribution: Exact eight-message, twelve-intermediate-state tree recurrence for the full super-domination cardinality polynomial of every finite forest; the lowest coefficient counts all minimum sets.
title: An explicit eight-state enumerator for all super-dominating sets of forests
